failure_reason: Akamai Bot Manager IP-level block hit after ~10 successful curl_cffi requests (consistent with prior Home-Decor pass notes: rotating-profile hit rate collapses once the workstation IP goes hot). Main Bestsellers PLP and the Kids Best Sellers PLP were opened and verified with exact counts before the block. Several genuine category-scoped Bestsellers children were discovered via the site's own PLP sitemap (naming convention identical to the verified pages) but could not be opened for count verification before the block hit, so they are recorded with qty:null and a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than fabricated numbers.
notes: Access: robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Used curl_cffi TLS impersonation per prior pass notes (assets/sitemap-plp.xml and sitemap-supercategory-and-spategory.xml unprotected, full mega-menu embedded in every page HTML). Checked: sitemap-plp.xml (1897 <loc> URLs) grepped for best/clearance/outlet/new-arriv/whats-new/sale/popular/trending/favorite terms; main nav mega-menu (embedded in /sale/ and /whats-new/new-arrivals-by-category/ page HTML); site's own 'Shop All' hub pages. /bestsellers/1 opened: title 'Bestsellers | Crate & Barrel', h1 'Bestsellers', data-num-results/totalCount agree at 228 - genuine undifferentiated PLP, no filter tabs to sub-bestseller pages on the page itself. Crate & Kids sub-brand has its own parallel Best Sellers PLP at /kids/shop-all-baby-kids-best-sellers/ (title 'Best Sellers | Crate & Kids', digitalData department=62, count 212) - treated as a sibling row, not a subset of the main 228, since Kids is a distinct department/brand tree (same pattern as the prior Lighting/Wall-Mirrors extraction which kept Kids rows separate from main-site rows). The PLP sitemap also lists /kids/best-sellers/1, which is very likely an alias of the verified /kids/shop-all-baby-kids-best-sellers/ (same 'Best Sellers | Crate & Kids' concept) - not added as a separate row to avoid an unconfirmed duplicate; noted here per the merge-decision requirement. Category-scoped 'best-selling-X' pages (furniture, lighting, dinnerware, cookware, rugs, decorating-and-accessories, outdoor-furniture, window-curtains under the main site; kids-bedroom and baby-nursery under Crate & Kids) are genuine site-published PLP-sitemap entries with an unambiguous naming convention identical to the verified pages - recorded as flagged children with qty:null (host blocked before they could be opened for a count). Two additional candidates were found but NOT recorded as rows because they were never opened and their category concept is genuinely mixed/unclear from the URL alone: /whats-new/new-bestsellers/1 (sits under the New Arrivals path, could be 'newly added items that are bestsellers' rather than a pure Bestsellers listing) and /sale/bestsellers-on-sale/1 (Bestsellers filtered by current sale status, may be a promotional intersection page rather than a standalone Bestsellers PLP) - flagging these from the sitemap alone without opening them would risk asserting a classification I could not verify; recommend a follow-up pass once the IP block clears. Excluded as out-of-scope for this brief (editorial/registry/trade, not merchandising Bestsellers PLPs): /wedding-gift-registry/best-registry-items/1, /baby-registry/best-baby-shower-gifts/1, /trade-program/bestsellers-designer-picks/1, /kids/best-christmas-gifts-ideas-for-kids/1, /kids/best-baby-christmas-gift-ideas/1, /christmas/christmas-best-sellers-back-in-stock/1 (seasonal/editorial gift-guide framing, not a standing merchandising PLP), /kids/best-selling-personalized-gifts/1 (personalization service page), and all '...favorite-products/1' / '...favorite-gifts/1' staff-pick and gift-guide pages under /crate-kitchen/, /baby-registry/, /gift-ideas/, /holiday/, /bed-and-bath/, /kids-room-ideas/ (editorial content, not PLPs).
